qualification_scope: All eight frozen ordinary cold requests, including both complete 512-output continuations and repaired q8193, pass the unchanged real-token/first-logit/streaming gate. This qualification does not cover arbitrary new prompts, general partial checkpoints, the long-context matrix, packaged HTTP or retained performance.
clock_interpretation: No --prefix-tokens request or externally precomputed seed is used. CLI callback clocks enclose every cold prefill stage; q8193 reports 63115.643 ms callback TTFT and 63115.4979 ms provider TTFT.
decision: Retain the dense neighboring-boundary and bounded prefill correctness fixes. Continue structural performance, arbitrary-length and partial-prefix correctness, and packaged API/release qualification. The fixed q8192 retained targets and outer 10-second limit remain unmet.
